character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every shot: sun-brown hair in a loose braid, clear forest-green eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult body proportions. They are a field naturalist documenting small signs of life in wild places. Fixed costume: a practical olive field jacket over a cream shirt, canvas trousers, and trail boots. Signature tool or keepsake: a leather-bound field journal with pressed leaves. Maintain the exact same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, proportions, costume silhouette, and signature object across the complete music video.
consistency_rules: One clearly defined protagonist leads this theme from beginning to end.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions in every scene.
Preserve the signature outfit, its color identity, and the defining tool or keepsake.
Do not redesign, replace, or multiply the lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require another person.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in wildflower meadow, ancient forest, rocky coast; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with leaf green, sky blue, soft white, sunset gold; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide landscape shot, slow tracking through grass, macro flower close-up; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
